I am a 53-year-old woman farmer in Kilimanjaro with some formal schooling. My 0.33 hectare plot is intercropped with beans, and I know beans can fix their own nitrogen from the air, so I do not need to buy expensive chemical fertilizer. I will spread manure from our household livestock to keep the soil fertile, and I will plant our local bean seeds that we saved from last season. With my family's help, we can manage the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves over about forty days this season.
